scope: Native Files stage; not final M11 media qualification
native_tasks: Graphical new-folder and text-file dialogs create actual native entries
Rename changes the persisted entry without losing the file
Copy/Paste publishes an actual desktop file and preserves the source
Cut/Paste moves the native file between folders
Recycle and Restore preserve the real payload and original location
Native details/icon view switches without changing stored items
Directory copy includes the real nested file payload
Collision requires review; Keep both preserves the existing directory and creates a separate tree
Guarded single-action Undo removes the unchanged copy and preserves its source
Directory rename atomically changes descendant paths
Recycling and restoring a directory preserves its nested file
Keyboard context menu creates a validated desktop shortcut to the selected real file
Escape cancels actual pointer file capture without removing its source
Ctrl-drag copies the actual file to the desktop with visible feedback and source preservation
Permanent deletion requires a separate cancel-first review; explicit confirmation removes only selected Bin payloads
Protected System Cut/Rename/Recycle are disabled with a reason; attempted Cut performs no metadata writes
Skip matches leaves a genuinely different destination file unchanged
Reviewed Replace verifies a staged copy before atomically replacing the closed native destination
Open with uses an installed handler and persists the requested extension association
Independent GPT/metadata/data inspection and detached disk startup preserve files and view preferences
Icons, size sorting and reverse direction affect the actual native Files window
Context Properties opens for the selected real file and closes through its owner dialog
Independent stored preference bytes and a second detached boot restore nondefault view, sort and direction
publication: Separate public website gate before M11.3
